newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lindeteves-Jacoberg in S$21 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Lindeteves-Jacoberg in S$21 mln contract.

text.p: Lindeteves-Jacoberg Ltd said on Monday it had been awarded a Singapore $21 million contract by the Singapore government for sludge treatment facilities.

The diversified engineering and trading company also said it had acquired the entire issued share capital of Howard Porter Pty Ltd and Howard Porter International Pty Ltd of Australia for a total consideration of Australian $4.08 million. The companies manufacture and distribute waste and material handling equipment.
Neither the Singapore contract nor the Australian acquisition will have a material impact on earnings in the current year, the company said.
